A

—

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Marc Lipsitch <mlip...@hsph.harvard.edu>
Date: Tue, May 5, 2015 at 9:35 AM
Subject: NIH-R01-funded postdoc in my group
To: "Marc Lipsitch" <MLIP...@hsph.harvard.edu>

Dear colleagues

Apologies for the group mail but I have an opening and am looking for a good postdoc to join my group to work on a project involving data analysisof data from experiments on unmanipulated, vaccinated, and genetically resistant rainbow trout (!) to characterize population-level heterogeneity in susceptibility to infection and the effects of vaccination and genetic resistance thereon. The second part of the work will be to use the results to structure and parameterize transmission-dynamic models. The project is in collaboration with (and led by) a PI at Virginia Institute of Marine Sciences, Andrew Wargo. Gabriela Gomes, soon to be at Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine, is also an important collaborator. Trout (and two pathogens, one bacterium and one virus) are a model system for understanding vertebrate immunity with high throughput for experimental studies.

Full information is here http://ccdd.hsph.harvard.edu/Opportunities 
and the advertisement is attached. Please share.

Thank you again
Marc
